== Title ==
<span lang="ja">ヴァーポレーター</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-41o-PSA.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">１フォース消費して、タトゥイーンの位置カードのどれかに配備する。移動不可。同じまたは隣接した位置カードにいるすべてのキャラクターは、「砂岩嵐」から防御される。</span><ref name="jp-face" />

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">砂漠の惑星には必要不可欠。大気中から水蒸気を凝集させる機械。浄化フィルターと冷却剤タンク付き。干ばつや苛酷な環境への対抗手段。</span><ref name="jp-face" />

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title:''' Vaporator.

'''Card text:''' Use 1 Force to deploy at any Tatooine location. Cannot move. All characters at the same or an adjacent location are protected from Sandwhirl.

'''Lore:''' An essential machine on desert planets that condenses water vapor from the air. It has a purification filter and coolant tank, and helps people cope with drought and harsh conditions.

== Statistics ==
* '''Destiny:''' 4
* '''Printed subtype:''' Item<ref name="jp-face" />
